description: This PHP class defines the ThemeModel for the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin's API layer. It models theme data related to colors, images, and branding properties, including serialization logic and entity initialization.

classes.name: ThemeModel
classes.description: Represents the theme data model used for serialization of branding theme information in the API, encapsulating colors, branding images, and related properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ThemeModel instance with a PartialTheme entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the ThemeModel to an array suitable for API response, including theme properties and conditional image filename inclusion.
